task:
对 Go 项目 /home/xieguiawu/Desktop/go-projects/news-report 做独立代码审查（只读，不修改任何文件）。这是一个新闻聚合器 CLI：从欧美权威媒体（英/德/法）抓取政治/经济/产业新闻，含 RSS/Atom/RDF 解析、HTML scrape 兑底、go-readability 全文提取、三语关键词分类、Jaccard 去重、权重×新鲜度排序、seen-store、robots.txt 尊重（按 UA 分组）。

审查重点：
1. 并发正确性：internal/report/report.go 的 worker pool（WaitGroup + sem）、seen-store 并发、FetchFulltext 的 map 写入是否安全
2. 数据竞争与 panic 风险：内部包全部（internal/fetch、feed、classify、dedup、rank、store、article、scrape、config、output、main.go）
3. 错误处理：fetch 重试逻辑（4xx 不重试、5xx 重试）、robots 判定（无法判定时允许）、feed 解析失败降级是否合理
4. 边界情况：feed 时间解析（未知时区）、空输入、超长响应、负数/零值配置
5. 安全：SSRF/路径穿越（URL 处理）、敏感信息硬编码、日志泄露
6. 测试质量：internal/*/ 下测试是否真实断言（quality gate 6）
7. 契约问题：跨包调用是否一致（如 Sources.Source 新增字段后所有构造路径是否正确）

输出：按严重度分级（CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW）列出问题，每条给文件:行号、问题描述、修复建议。不要修改代码，只报告。

residualRisks: UTF-8 truncation (C1/C2) will produce corrupt text for German/French news with accented characters at truncation boundary — high probability, low severity per instance
Unknown TZ abbreviation handling (H3) introduces up to 12h timestamp skew — news from feeds using abbreviated non-UTC zones will have wrong freshness scores
Seen-store write failures are silently lost (M5) — on full disk, subsequent runs re-display all items as new
No tests for output/ and sources/ packages — rendering regressions and source list bugs won't be caught by CI
SSRF risk via 'read' command is minimal (local CLI) but the URL gate is weaker than its error message claims (H5)

childReport.manualNotes: Concurrency design is solid: WaitGroup+semaphore pattern is correct, seen-store uses mutex properly, FetchFulltext writes to distinct slice elements avoiding races. Race detector confirms. Primary issues are text encoding correctness (UTF-8 byte-vs-rune confusion) and error handling robustness, not concurrency bugs. Test coverage is good for core logic but output/sources packages are untested. E2E with --live flag may leave goroutines blocked on channel send briefly on timeout but they eventually drain.
